source_policy: Use exact-title scholarly discovery, then verify venue and metadata against an official conference, publisher, DOI, or preprint record. Do not promote a search-result venue without primary-source confirmation.
dataset_policy: Record separately the datasets used for self-supervised or backbone pretraining and the datasets used for downstream evaluation. Preserve named benchmark suites and explicitly label unnamed private collections.

records.normalized_title: self supervised object centric learning for videos

updates.method_description: Spatiotemporal slot attention learns object-centric video representations through high-level feature reconstruction, masking, and adaptive slot merging.
updates.audit_notes: The official proceedings place this paper in NeurIPS 2023, not 2024.

records.normalized_title: language based action concept spaces improve video self supervised learning

updates.method_description: GPT-3 action descriptions define language concept spaces for self-distillation, relation regularization, video adaptation, and cross-dataset transfer.
updates.dataset_notes: Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 labels form the base concept vocabulary; the self-supervised training phase itself uses Kinetics-400 videos.
updates.audit_notes: The official proceedings place this paper in NeurIPS 2023, not 2024.

records.normalized_title: uncovering the hidden dynamics of video self supervised learning under distribution shifts

updates.method: Controlled comparison of v-SimCLR, v-MoCo, v-BYOL, v-SimSiam, v-DINO, and v-MAE
updates.method_description: A controlled empirical study measures how six video SSL paradigms transfer under in-domain, out-of-context, cross-view, synthetic, and image-domain shifts.

updates.audit_notes: The official proceedings place this paper in NeurIPS 2023, not 2024.

records.normalized_title: self supervised video pretraining yields robust and more human aligned visual representation

updates.method_description: Multi-scale temporally varying contrastive views with learned attention pooling train image representations on a curated ImageNet-matched video corpus.

updates.audit_notes: The official proceedings place this paper in NeurIPS 2023, not 2024.

records.normalized_title: adamae adaptive masking for efficient spatiotemporal learning with masked autoencoders

updates.method_description: An adaptive token sampler learns where to mask so that a masked autoencoder spends reconstruction capacity on informative spatiotemporal regions.

records.normalized_title: spatio temporal crop aggregation for video representation learning

updates.method_description: SCALE aggregates a set of frozen-backbone clip features with masked clip modeling and set-level contrastive learning to represent short and long videos.

updates.audit_notes: The arXiv-only venue was promoted to the final ICCV 2023 proceedings record.

records.normalized_title: motion guided masking for spatiotemporal representation learning

updates.method_description: Motion vectors guide the mask distribution toward dynamic regions while retaining a small amount of context for masked video reconstruction.

records.normalized_title: fine grained spatiotemporal motion alignment for contrastive video representation learning

updates.method_description: Fine-grained motion alignment combines local pixel-level motion reconstruction with global and local contrastive objectives.

records.normalized_title: concatenated masked autoencoders as spatial temporal learner

records.normalized_title: masked motion encoding for self supervised video representation learning
